question: Who was appointed as the Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau on 17 September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Garg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Anurag Garg, a 1993 batch IPS officer from the Himachal Pradesh cadre, has been appointed as the new Director General (DG) of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB).​
